items.name: GuildRanking
items.template: Each guild has its own board: you are ranked against the other members of your guild, not guild against guild. Each Play adds 1 to 100 points to your total for today's season, and seasons turn over every day at 00:00 UTC. Once a season is over, receive coins for it by the rank you finished at in your guild: 1st 300, top 3 150, top 10 50. Advance one day moves your clock forward 24 hours, so the season you played is over for you and can be received now. It moves only your account's clock on GS2. Guildmates who did not advance are still in the earlier season, so your board shows the new season, with only the members who advanced and played in it. A guild holds at most ten members at once, but the scores of members who left stay on its board, so 11th place or lower earns nothing. A guild of one always finishes 1st, so founding a guild alone pays the top tier. A reward is received once per guild and season, so a player who scores in one guild and then in another, even one they founded again after disbanding the first, receives again for the same season as a different guild. This demo allows both because its coins are play money.
